waivers.reason: Needs a real Wayland compositor and an NVIDIA GPU; GitHub-hosted runners have neither. The pure decision (which env overrides a target needs) is unit-tested in platform.rs, but the scenario itself — a window actually opening without a Wayland protocol crash — cannot be asserted headless.

No macOS or Windows runner is available to the test suite, and installing a package on host OS is not something a headless Linux test run can assert. Cross-platform package creation is verified by automated release workflow dry-runs, and installation behavior is validated via manual verification.
